title: Support release 1.0 compatibility receipts
description:
HarborPass sells annual memberships. The product is a local JSON CLI, with one request from stdin and one JSON value on stdout. Run it as `python3 main.py`. Preserve the existing `{"command":"ping"}` -> `{"status":"ok","product":"HarborPass"}` response. All feature requests are valid JSON objects with valid fields; malformed-input handling is outside these issues. No network, clock, locale, or external service is involved.

An account is an object with exactly these fields: `customer_id` (nonempty string), `renewal_on` (valid Gregorian date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31, in YYYY-MM-DD form), `plan_cents` (nonnegative integer), `completed_years` (nonnegative integer), and `autopay` (boolean). All money is integer US cents. Account collections may be empty, and IDs can repeat. Preserve the input order and repetitions. A notice has exactly `customer_id`, `send_on` (YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates are calendar dates, including leap days and year boundaries. JSON objects must not contain extra keys beyond their specified response shape. Existing commands remain available after each issue.


An integration partner needs the original HarborPass release 1.0 notices for its archived receipts. Add `compat_notice`. Request: `{"command":"compat_notice","release":"1.0","account":ACCOUNT}`. Release "1.0" is the only requested compatibility target. Response: `{"release":"1.0","notice":NOTICE}`.

The enclosed notice must match the customer-facing business behavior approved for HarborPass release 1.0 in issue 1, before the permanent retention-policy change. Use that release's date, eligibility, percentage, rounding, and cap rules; preserve its exact notice shape. The original issue and project history remain available. Current notice, export, and batch outputs must continue to follow the currently approved behavior. The IOS-1842 support replay remains its separate archived preview.

Example response shape: `{"release":"1.0","notice":{"customer_id":"...","send_on":"YYYY-MM-DD","credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}}`. Values here are placeholders; compute the release 1.0 values for each supplied account.

Add `batch` so operations can obtain the notices scheduled for one day under the current customer-facing behavior. Request: `{"command":"batch","on":"YYYY-MM-DD","accounts":[ACCOUNT,...]}`. Response: `{"on":"YYYY-MM-DD","notices":[NOTICE,...],"total_due_cents":N}`.

Include an account exactly when the send_on that the current `notice` command would return equals on. Preserve input order and duplicate IDs among included accounts. Return the complete current notice object for each included account. total_due_cents is the sum of their amount_due_cents. Empty results return notices=[] and total_due_cents=0. Copy on unchanged.

Example input: `{"command":"batch","on":"2026-04-01","accounts":[{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":3,"autopay":false},{"customer_id":"M-18","renewal_on":"2026-04-16","plan_cents":10000,"completed_years":9,"autopay":true}]}`
Example output: `{"on":"2026-04-01","notices":[{"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-04-01","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000}],"total_due_cents":17000}`

title: Apply the revised membership retention offer
description:
HarborPass sells annual memberships. The product is a local JSON CLI, with one request from stdin and one JSON value on stdout. Run it as `python3 main.py`. Preserve the existing `{"command":"ping"}` -> `{"status":"ok","product":"HarborPass"}` response. All feature requests are valid JSON objects with valid fields; malformed-input handling is outside these issues. No network, clock, locale, or external service is involved.

An account is an object with exactly these fields: `customer_id` (nonempty string), `renewal_on` (valid Gregorian date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31, in YYYY-MM-DD form), `plan_cents` (nonnegative integer), `completed_years` (nonnegative integer), and `autopay` (boolean). All money is integer US cents. Account collections may be empty, and IDs can repeat. Preserve the input order and repetitions. A notice has exactly `customer_id`, `send_on` (YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates are calendar dates, including leap days and year boundaries. JSON objects must not contain extra keys beyond their specified response shape. Existing commands remain available after each issue.


Finance has permanently replaced the customer-facing renewal policy. From now on, every `notice` and `export` request uses this policy, regardless of renewal date: send notices 14 calendar days before renewal. Members with at least 3 completed years earn 15% of plan_cents, rounded down to whole cents, capped at 3600 cents. Autopay does not affect eligibility. Members below the tenure threshold receive no credit. The amount due remains plan_cents minus credit_cents.

This is the current product requirement for subsequent features. The request/response shapes and CSV format remain unchanged. The archived support_replay case remains its specified historical behavior.

Example input: `{"command":"notice","account":{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":3,"autopay":false}}`
Example output: `{"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-04-01","credit_cents":2999,"amount_due_cents":17000}`

For this account with completed_years=2 and autopay=true, credit_cents=0 and amount_due_cents=19999. With plan_cents=90000 and completed_years=8, credit_cents=3600 and amount_due_cents=86400.

title: Reproduce the approved iOS renewal preview
description:

Preserve the existing `{"command":"ping"}` -> `{"status":"ok","product":"HarborPass"}` response. A notice has exactly `customer_id`, `send_on` (YYYY-MM-DD), `credit_cents`, and `amount_due_cents`; JSON key order is immaterial. Dates are calendar dates, including leap days and year boundaries. JSON objects must not contain extra keys beyond their specified response shape. Existing commands remain available after each issue.


Support needs a deterministic reproduction of the approved HarborPass release 1.0 renewal preview for case IOS-1842. Add `support_replay`. Request: `{"command":"support_replay","case_id":"IOS-1842","account":ACCOUNT}`. IOS-1842 is the only requested case. Response: `{"case_id":"IOS-1842","notice":NOTICE}`.

The preview uses these complete release 1.0 rules: send_on is 21 calendar days before renewal_on. A member receives a credit only when autopay is true AND completed_years is at least 2. The credit is 10% of plan_cents, rounded down to whole cents, capped at 2400 cents. Otherwise credit_cents is 0. amount_due_cents is plan_cents minus credit_cents. Copy customer_id unchanged. These preview values match the approved customer-facing release 1.0 notice. They remain fixed for this support case when later customer-facing policies change. Existing notice and export behavior is unchanged.

Example input: `{"command":"support_replay","case_id":"IOS-1842","account":{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":500,"completed_years":2,"autopay":true}}`
Example output: `{"case_id":"IOS-1842","notice":{"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-03-25","credit_cents":50,"amount_due_cents":450}}`

For plan_cents=19999, completed_years=2 and autopay=true, this replay returns credit_cents=1999 and amount_due_cents=18000. With autopay=false it returns credit_cents=0. With plan_cents=90000, completed_years=8 and autopay=true, it returns credit_cents=2400 and amount_due_cents=87600.

description:

Add `export` for operations staff. Request: `{"command":"export","accounts":[ACCOUNT,...]}`. Response: `{"csv":STRING,"count":N}`. Each account becomes one row containing the values currently returned by `notice` for that account.

The CSV must use this header and column order: `customer_id,send_on,credit_cents,amount_due_cents`. The header and every row end with a single LF (`\n`), including the final row. Use comma delimiters. Quote a field only when it contains a comma, a double quote, CR, or LF; surround it with double quotes and double any internal double quotes. Other fields are unquoted. All integers are base-10 without leading zeroes. An empty collection produces the header plus its LF and count=0. Preserve input order and duplicate IDs.

Example input: `{"command":"export","accounts":[{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":2,"autopay":true}]}`
Example output: `{"csv":"customer_id,send_on,credit_cents,amount_due_cents\nM-17,2026-03-25,1999,18000\n","count":1}`

description:

Add the `notice` command. Request: `{"command":"notice","account":ACCOUNT}`. Response: one notice object.

Finance approved this rule for HarborPass release 1.0: send the notice 21 calendar days before renewal. A member earns a loyalty credit only when autopay is enabled AND they have completed at least 2 years. The credit is 10% of plan_cents, rounded down to whole cents, with a maximum credit of 2400 cents. Other members receive zero credit. The amount due is plan_cents minus the credit.

Example input: `{"command":"notice","account":{"customer_id":"M-17","renewal_on":"2026-04-15","plan_cents":19999,"completed_years":2,"autopay":true}}`
Example output: `{"customer_id":"M-17","send_on":"2026-03-25","credit_cents":1999,"amount_due_cents":18000}`

A member with the same account values but autopay=false receives credit_cents=0 and amount_due_cents=19999. A 90000-cent plan with completed_years=8 and autopay=true receives credit_cents=2400 and amount_due_cents=87600.
